dialogues.speaker: Shagova
dialogues.text: Oh dear... I didn't mean for you to hear me, dear passenger. I am truly sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Shagova
dialogues.text: I am Shagova, train attendant at Sretomorozsk. I started at this job less than a year ago...

dialogues.speaker: Shagova
dialogues.text: The stationmaster said, he thinks I have a lot of potential. He told me that if I just work hard, I'll be promoted to Snezhnograd someday... Heh, I can't believe I just said that out loud!

dialogues.speaker: Shagova
dialogues.text: But... I've made up my mind. I'm going to work really hard from now on so they can really see what I can do!

dialogues.speaker: Shagova
dialogues.text: Although... the station's been pretty quiet since we haven't had many visitors to Sretomorozsk lately. That might put a bit of a damper on things...

dialogues.speaker: Shagova
dialogues.text: But that's all right! Yeah. I'll just have to keep doing every single thing right. As they say, opportunity favors the prepared.
